Write the skeleton of the whole game as one TypeScript code block: types, top-level variables with their types, and every function with its full typed signature and a one-line comment above it saying what it does. // Types
type Board = string[];

// Top-level variables
const board: Board = [];
const boardIndex = 0;
const boardSize = 3;

// Function to create the game board
function createBoard(): Board {
  return Array(9)
    .fill(' ')
    .map((_, index) => {
      return index < boardIndex ? index + 1 : index;
    })
    .map((_, index) => board[index] || '');
}

// Function to update the board with a move
function updateBoard(index: number, value: string): Board {
  const board = boardIndex === index ? board : board.slice();
  board[index] = value;
  return board;
}

// Function to check if a move is valid
function isMoveValid(index: number): boolean {
  return index >= 0 && index < boardSize && board[index] === '';
}

// Function to check if a player has won
function checkWin(player: string): boolean {
  const winConditions = [
    [0, 1, 2], [3, 4, 5], [6, 7, 8],
    [0, 3, 6], [1, 4, 7], [2, 5, 8],
    [0, 4, 8], [2, 4, 6]
  ];
  for (const [row] of winConditions) {
    if (board[row[0]] === player && board[row[1]] === player && board[row[2]] === player) {
      return true;
    }
  }
  return false;
}

// Function to check if the game is over
function checkGameOver(): boolean {
  const win = checkWin(boardIndex);
  const draw = board.every((_, index) => boardIndex === index);
  return win || draw;
}

// Function to determine the current player
function getCurrentPlayer(): string {
  return board[boardIndex] ? board[boardIndex] : 'X';
}

// Function to determine if the game is a draw
function isDraw(): boolean {
  return checkGameOver() && board.every((_, index) => boardIndex === index);
}

// Function to check if the current player has a move available
function isMoveAvailable(): boolean {
  return isMoveValid(boardIndex) && !checkGameOver();
}

// Function to handle the game initialization
function initializeGame(): void {
  board = createBoard();
  boardIndex = 0;
  boardSize = 3;
  setBoard(board);
  updateBoard(boardIndex, 'X');
  setCurrentPlayer('X');
  setDraw(false);
  setGameOver(false);
  setMoveAvailable(true);
}

// Function to handle the restart
function restartGame(): void {
  board = createBoard();
  boardIndex = 0;
  boardSize = 3;
  updateBoard(boardIndex, 'X');
  setCurrentPlayer('X');
  setDraw(false);
  setGameOver(false);
  setMoveAvailable(true);
}

// Function to handle the computer's move
function getComputerMove(): string {
  const availableMoves = isMoveAvailable() ? availableMoves : [];
  if (availableMoves.length === 0) {
    return 'X';
  }
  // Randomly pick a move
  const moveIndex = Math.floor(Math.random() * availableMoves.length);
  return availableMoves[moveIndex];
}

// Function to check if the computer has won
function checkComputerWin(computerPlayer: string): boolean {
  const winConditions = [
    [0, 1, 2], [3, 4, 5], [6, 7, 8],
    [0, 3, 6], [1, 4, 7], [2, 5, 8],
    [0, 4, 8], [2, 4, 6]
  ];
  for (const [row] of winConditions) {
    if (board[row[0]] === computerPlayer && board[row[1]] === computerPlayer && board[row[2]] === computerPlayer) {
      return true;
    }
  }
  return false;
}

// Function to check if the computer has a move available
function isComputerMoveAvailable(): boolean {
  return isMoveAvailable() && !checkComputerWin('O');
}

// Function to handle the computer's move
function computerMove(): string {
  const availableMoves = isMoveAvailable() ? availableMoves : [];
  if (availableMoves.length === 0) {
    return 'O';
  }
  // Randomly pick a move
  const moveIndex = Math.floor(Math.random() * availableMoves.length);
  return availableMoves[moveIndex];
}

// Function to handle the game state updates
function updateGameState(index: number, value: string): void {
  board = updateBoard(index, value);
  updateBoard(boardIndex, value);
  setCurrentPlayer(value);
  setDraw(!isDraw());
  setGameOver(checkGameOver());
  setMoveAvailable(isMoveAvailable());
}

// Function to handle the restart
function restartGame(): void {
  initializeGame();
}

// Function to handle the game initialization
initializeGame();
